allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Lecteurs disponibles ==="; Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name, @{N='Racine';E={$_.Root}}, @{N='Libellé';E={\(Get-Volume -DriveLetter $_.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).FileSystemLabel}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output "=== Recherche d'un dossier 'Mon Drive' / 'My Drive' ==="; foreach\($d in \(Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem\).Root\){ foreach\($n in @\('Mon Drive','My Drive'\)\){ $p=Join-Path $d $n; if\(Test-Path $p\){ Write-Output "TROUVÉ : $p" } } })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Contenu de G:\\Mon Drive ==="; Get-ChildItem "G:\\Mon Drive" -Force | Select-Object Name, Mode, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize; $p="G:\\Mon Drive\\Appli Capital"; if\(Test-Path $p\){ Write-Output "=== Contenu de la copie existante : $p ==="; Get-ChildItem $p -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Output "Pas de dossier 'Appli Capital' déjà présent dans Mon Drive." })
